newsitem.title: NEPAL: Nepali rupee unchanged vs dlr, dlr shortage likely.
newsitem.headline: Nepali rupee unchanged vs dlr, dlr shortage likely.

text.p: The Nepali rupee opened unchanged at 56.98-57.00 rupees per dollar on Wednesday, dealers said.
There is a shortage of dollars in the market due to the large oil import payments settled this week, a dealer said.
The Nepal Oil Corporation (NOC) a state owned corporation paid $7.8 million towards the payment of petroleum products, he said.
"Bankers have asked the central bank to intervene and supply dollars to the market," he added.
Nepal Rastra Bank, the kingdom's central bank, quoted its rupee-dollar rate at 56.75-57.30 rupees per dollar.
Inter-bank call money rates opened at 9.25-9.30 percent on Wednesday, against the previous close of 9.25 percent, dealers said.
